title: Portable character chronicle (character-scoped memory vs campaign canon)
description:
A character carries subjective, portable memory — relationships, scars, debts, vows, titles, subjective knowledge, and campaign-participation history — that travels across campaigns, distinct from campaign-owned OBJECTIVE world canon. Define a CharacterChronicle separate from the mechanical CharacterSheet, attached to the global character identity (registry, ADR 0012), with source campaign/session provenance and portability/visibility flags.

On entering a campaign, selected chronicle facts inform character context WITHOUT being asserted as that campaign's world facts (Mira remembers King Aldren; Campaign B's world does not automatically contain him). Intersects the existing memory subsystem (docs/memory/, campaign bible / arc / session recap) — must not blindly merge prior-campaign world canon into new campaigns. Out of scope for the progression/leveling beads.
design: Design kickoff in docs/design/character-chronicle.md. Epic decomposed into child beads: .16.2 registry model/store, .16.3 release capture, .16.4 context injection, .16.1 CLI curation. Storage/model is the first implementation dependency; chronicle context must stay separate from campaign bible/overlay lore.
acceptance_criteria:
- A CharacterChronicle model, separate from CharacterSheet, attaches to the global character identity with source campaign/session provenance and portability/visibility flags.
- Character-scoped facts travel across campaigns; campaign-scoped world facts do not.
- Entering a campaign surfaces selected chronicle facts as character context, never as asserted world canon.
- Integration with the existing memory subsystem is defined.
- (Decomposed into children before implementation.)
